criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Nine different worlds, vivid V2; strongest 7, 9, 1. Held down by 4 (empty top, screen aliasing), 6 (void, about 17 of 42 visible), 8 (no parents), 2 (low detail desks, tiny custodian).

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Spine holds and the story runs in order; the accent's meaning blurs on 8 (bus yellow) and 9 (warm lamp glow); 7 crimson tab off palette.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and drawn counts match. Slide 4 set the 86 and the 29 on the same hundred desks as a per-leader cross-tab the source never gives. Looser: slide 8 hook universal, slide 9 'its 42 states' ambiguous and drops 'some form of', document title drops attribution, 'school leaders' drops 'and district'. Single advocacy source, no named pollster.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Clear finding, who said it, one action; no decision, body, deadline or Texas place.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover leads with 29, frame 2 pays, turn at 4, close hands over an action; 3 and 8 could move.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean; 'reported' and 'drawn to illustrate' everywhere; no Texas place.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh topic; the counted drawing unit is the fourth in four days.

hard_fails: Slide 4 sets two survey shares against each other: it lights FIG.teacher_use_of_100 laptops and places FIG.student_policy_of_100 folders on the same hundred desks, each desk one leader, implying a per-leader joint distribution Texas 2036 never publishes; the hook read 29 against 86. Repair: drop the lit laptops or give the 29 their own unit set and strike 'The same desks' and 'The lit laptops still mark reported teacher use'.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Top 55 percent empty wall, desks crushed low, screens alias, flat folders; carries the integrity fault.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera nearer the first row, remove the laptops' encoding, folders with thickness and contact, late sun.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Binders in a flat blue void, about 17 of 42 readable.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Library interior behind; pull back so all 42 and the empty slot read.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No parents; the bus is the whole subject and competes with amber.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back, two or three parents at the covered walk, cooler bus yellow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: High camera flattens the desks; scale figure a few pixels.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Eye about 4 m, longer lens, custodian near left foreground.
